docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A tutorial and reference for the Python language: getting started, data types and operators, control flow, functions, classes and objects, exceptions, modules and packages, the standard library, and advanced topics.

From Wikibooks · CC BY-SA 4.0

Python Programming, a Wikibooks textbook, by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikibooks when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Modified: converted to this format.
